messages:
alice_sales: Heads-up — FinSight POC streaming is dropping after ~3-5m when routed through their corporate proxy. Node SDK works fine; Python SDK stalls then we see connection resets. Anyone hit flaky keep-alive / HTTP/2 proxy behavior before?

devon_eng: which Python client + HTTP lib are they using? streaming via SSE/chunked or full bidirectional? any logs?

alice_sales: Using our Python SDK 0.9.3 (async) layered on aiohttp. It's server-streaming (chunked responses) for long completions. Quick paste of the error from their side: 
```
ERROR: aiohttp.client_exceptions.ServerDisconnectedError: 500, message='Connection lost while reading'
...
TRACE: HTTP/2 RST_STREAM (0x1) / GOAWAY id=0x0
```
They see it repeatedly after a few minutes. No obvious 429s.

zara_infra: Proxy vendor (BlueCorp) frequently tears idle HTTP/2 sessions when it thinks they're inactive. Python libs keep different defaults for TCP keepalive vs Node. Node probably had a longer keepalive ping or different connection pooling, so it survives.

tim_sre: Quick mitigation: enable TCP keepalive on the Python socket and limit connection pooling to avoid reusing a stale connection. Also try forcing HTTP/1.1 (short term) to see if the proxy's HTTP/2 implementation is the culprit.

devon_eng: can you ask them to try a patched client config? two examples below that have helped other customers:

Python (aiohttp) snippet:
```python
import aiohttp
conn = aiohttp.TCPConnector(limit=1, keepalive_timeout=60)  # small pool + keepalive timeout
async with aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=conn) as s:
    await s.get(url)
```

Node (undici) snippet (for parity):
```js
const { Agent } = require('undici')
const agent = new Agent({ connections: 1, keepAliveTimeout: 60000 })
fetch(url, { dispatcher: agent })
```

devon_eng: also set our SDK option `stream_timeout_ms` to something slightly higher and `max_concurrency: 1` for the POC so the client opens fewer concurrent connections.

alice_sales: Customer tried the Python TCPConnector change and reported fewer drops, but still seeing a reset occasionally. They said infra team will try to bump proxy idle timeout.

zara_infra: If the proxy still closes streams, two ops fixes: (1) enable HTTP/2 ping/keepalive at proxy <-> backend, or (2) let the client use HTTP/1.1 chunked streaming which many proxies handle more predictably. Ops will triage on their side.

tim_sre: FYI we pushed a small SDK guidance doc snippet to the KB: "when operating behind corporate proxies that terminate TLS, prefer keepalive-enabled connectors and reduce connection reuse for long-lived streaming sessions." linking it here: https://intra.redwood/KB/proxy-streaming-guidance :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy status: no active deploys to streaming infra in last 2 hours.

devon_eng: action items: (1) I will prepare a one-pager with exact Python/Node config to hand to their infra; (2) pro-tip: if they cannot change proxy timeout, recommend switching to HTTP/1.1 streaming in the short term; (3) track any GOAWAY/RST codes and timestamp them so we can correlate with proxy logs.

alice_sales: thanks — I'll schedule a 30m call with FinSight infra and share the one-pager. Sales ask: any impact to pricing/commit? nothing immediate, just POC fragility.

devon_eng: no pricing impact; just note the POC needs a small config change. I'll drop the config examples and a minimal troubleshooting checklist in the call notes.

alice_sales: great, assigning follow-up to @devon_eng. I'll update FinSight and move to a short technical deep-dive tomorrow. :calendar:
